conflict_flags.rationale: BOD cover header 'Naval Station – Norfolk, Virginia' refers to the administering command's home base (NAVFAC Mid-Atlantic / Naval Station Norfolk), not the physical project site. Both the BOD body text and the SAES consistently and specifically locate the physical site at West Norfolk Road, Portsmouth, VA on leased private property adjacent to the Elizabeth River. Minor severity because the conflict is easily explained by contracting-vs-physical-site distinction and poses no risk to downstream pursuit accuracy.
